panels.heading: Up the strings
panels.altText: Ascending finger-per-fret exercise for four-string bass in standard notation and TAB, using frets 9, 10, 11 and 12.
panels.description: Play frets 9, 10, 11 and 12 on each string, moving from the E string to the G string. Orange numbers show fretting-hand fingers.

panels.heading: Back down
panels.altText: Descending finger-per-fret exercise for four-string bass in standard notation and TAB, using frets 12, 11, 10 and 9.
panels.description: Play frets 12, 11, 10 and 9 on each string, moving from the G string to the E string. Orange numbers show fretting-hand fingers.
